host: Apple M2 Max (8P+4E), shared host with other agents; 1-minute load average 6-15 during the runs (recorded per run); no load gating. Prefer cycles/VIN and within-session ordering over absolute VIN/s.

synthetic_2m.path: first 2,000,000 lines of target/bench/realistic-corpus.txt (one-worker runs only, to keep them short)

probe: crates/ultravin/examples/native_slot_grid.rs: warm whole-corpus pass, then one timed whole-corpus pass; fixed clock 1788220800000000; ULTRAVIN_RESULT_CACHE at its default (16,384 entries)
rounds: two rounds per cell; plan order reversed in the second round
